image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a modern steam iron resting on a textured fabric surface. The iron features a white and dark grey/black body with blue translucent accents near the water tank area. The soleplate is visible at the bottom, appearing dark and smooth. The background is a blurred, neutral grey wall.

The boundary between the soleplate and the fabric is slightly soft and indistinct, lacking the sharp contact shadow expected from a heavy metal object resting on cloth.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a steam iron and not a similar-looking appliance.
To verify the physical contact between the heavy iron and the soft fabric, checking for floating artifacts or incorrect depth ordering.
To ensure the handle and body are seamlessly connected and the plastic molding does not show signs of melting or fusion errors.

focus_areas: Realism of the translucent blue plastic material
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'floating' nature of the iron. AI generators often struggle with the weightiness of objects on soft surfaces. Check if the fabric depresses realistically under the iron's weight. Also, scrutinize the blue window for 'melted' textures which are common in AI renders of transparent parts.
